nav.installIOS: To install Résonance on your phone: tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up), then choose "Add to Home Screen".
nav.installMac: To install Résonance on your Mac: in the "File" menu at the top of the screen, choose "Add to Dock" (or click the Share icon in Safari's toolbar, then "Add to Dock").
nav.installGeneric: To install Résonance: look in your browser's menu for an "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen" option (often a ⊕ icon or a ⋮ menu in the address bar).
hero.title: Your music, your platform, your rules.
hero.lede: Résonance hosts your tracks, links to your streaming platforms, and lets your audience support you directly. Made solo, with a band, or with the help of AI: your music belongs here.
hero.installNote: 📲 Installable as an app on your phone (button at the top of the page). On iPhone: Share button → "Add to Home Screen", two steps.
how.title: How it works
how.lede: Three steps between your track and your audience.
how.step1.title: Host and stream
how.step1.body: Upload your audio file, add a genre — it appears instantly in the public catalog, playable right in the browser.
how.step2.title: Get supported
how.step2.body: A support link (Ko-fi, PayPal, Tipeee…) appears on your profile and tracks. Any listener can support you in one click.
how.step3.title: Link your platforms
how.step3.body: Add your Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud or Instagram links: Résonance becomes your central page.

discover.parentalInfo: Résonance lets you hide tracks flagged as containing explicit language, locked with a PIN only a parent knows. Set it up directly on your child's device. Designed to support families up to France's digital age of consent (15), it's a simple, honest filter — not an identity check.
